title: Kazime muztar
body:
qaid mein chauda baras zulm o sitam dhaaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
phir nishane ismate sadaat mitwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid kar ke le ke aaye kazim e naushad ko
phir azadar e janabe syed e sajjad ko
paon mein bedi galay mein tauq pehnaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
yaad abid ki aseeri aagayi rote rahe
pesh e haakim pa barehna haye peshi ke liye
jis ghadi sarkar ko darbar mein laaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
char jaanib ghup andhera tha ke jaise qabr ho
qaid khana aisa lagta tha ke jaise qabr ho
jeete jee is qabr mein maula ko dalwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaid khane ki aziyat kam thi kya ay zaalimon
kyun nabi ki aal se itni adawat hai kaho
dhaa liye sab zulm to phir zeher dilwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis tarha zainab hui thi apne baba se juda
be-padar masooma e qum bhi hui wa ghurbata
bekhata jaise ali ko qatl karwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema sughra ko jaise yaad karte thay hussain
us tarha milta na tha beti ke bin kazim ko chain
qaid khane ko bhi baitul huzn banwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
chand mazdooron ne laashe ko uthaya aap ke
aur janaza pul pe laa ke rakh diya baghdad ke
haye zanjeeron mein bhi mayyat ko bandhwaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghul hua kaunain mein maara gaya ek be-khata
hogaye hai be-padar maula raza yasir raza
haye masooma ke sar se baap ka saaya gaya
kazim e muztar ko tadpaya gaya
qaid mein chauda baras...
author: Yasir Raza
